questions.stem: What is the difference between a dipeptide and a polypeptide?

options.text: A dipeptide contains two peptide bonds while a polypeptide contains one
A dipeptide is made of two amino acids joined by a peptide bond, while a polypeptide is a long chain of many amino acids
A polypeptide is a type of carbohydrate
There is no difference; they are the same thing

questions.explanation: A dipeptide consists of two amino acids joined by one peptide bond. A polypeptide is a long chain of many amino acids (typically more than 20) joined by many peptide bonds.
